example.title: Two-storey net shed with a railed upper gallery (right)
example.place: Fishermen's Terminal, Seattle, King County, WA

brief: A 1980s two-storey net shed: blue corrugated metal, a row of tall blue roll-up doors, a railed gallery along the upper floor under the shallow gable, and a sign board 'Net Shed'. One photo (the right-hand shed). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
